sources.note: ESM-2's own paper, and the first-party statement of what ESM-2 was trained on. Retrieved 2026-10-14 after the earlier HTTP 429 lifted; the host rate-limits bursts rather than sustaining a block, so one request every few minutes succeeds where repeated attempts do not. NOTE ON THE CHECKSUM: biorxiv.org stamps the download time into the PDF's XMP ModifyDate and MetadataDate, so the bytes differ on every fetch and this sha256 will NOT reproduce. Verified by comparing this capture against an independently downloaded copy: 30 bytes differ, all of them in those two timestamps, and the extracted text is identical. So the hash fixes this capture, not the document.

sources.note: Version of record, MAIN ARTICLE ONLY (10 pages), retrieved 2026-10-16 by the project owner. Status is retrieved_not_stored rather than retrieved: the other captures in pdfs/ are CC-BY-family preprints and are committed, but this is an all-rights-reserved subscription article, so redistributing it in this repository is not something its licence permits. The sha256 is recorded so a reader with their own copy can confirm they hold the same bytes; because nothing is stored, no quote may cite this id, which tools/policies.py enforces. WHAT IT SETTLES: the main text contains no occurrence of 'Denylist', 'identity threshold' or 'Select Agent' — zero, machine-checked across all 10 pages — and defers throughout to 'supplementary materials, section A.x'. WHAT IS STILL MISSING: the supplementary materials, whose section A.6 is where the preprint puts the two denylists and the unnumbered threshold (preprint p67). That file is the open item against D-106, not this one. Earlier check (A1.5, 2026-10-15) established only that no correction is registered against this DOI.

sources.title: Nguyen et al. 2024 — Sequence modeling and design from molecular to genome scale (Science, version of record)
sources.note: Supplied by the project owner 2026-10-17, after the audit registered it as blocked (science.org 403; PMC page served a reCAPTCHA behind an HTTP 200). WHAT IT SETTLES: unlike ESM3, the version of record carries the whole viral exclusion procedure in the MAIN TEXT, p12 ('OpenGenome datasets'), not in the supplement. Compared character by character against the preprint's Appendix B.2 (whitespace and hyphenation normalised), the procedure paragraph is identical but for two copy-edits: 'High-confidence' is lowercased to 'high-confidence', and an 'and' is inserted before the last order. All 19 families, all 12 orders and all 8 stop taxa are present, with no name in either source that the specs do not carry, and the stated counts '19 families' and '12 orders' match the lists. The data availability statement names the OpenGenome release this audit staged (huggingface.co/datasets/LongSafari/open-genome, training/validation/test splits) and lists the three pretraining sources, with no viral screening step described for GTDB or IMG/PR. Licence: a subscription article, committed by the project owner as the ESM3 supplement was; worth revisiting before this repository is made public. See DECISIONS.md D-110.

sources.title: Nguyen et al. 2024 — Sequence modeling and design from molecular to genome scale: supplementary materials (version of record)
sources.note: Supplied by the project owner 2026-10-17, after the audit registered it as blocked (science.org 403; PMC page served a reCAPTCHA behind an HTTP 200). 55 pages. Carries no part of the exclusion procedure — that is in the main text — but two things bear on this audit. Table S2 (p35) publishes the IMG/VR subset as 2,653,046 genomes, 36,236 M bases, average length 13,658, which A7.1's own census of the staged release matches at 2,653,047 records, 36,236,025,613 bases and mean 13,658.4: one record apart, and agreeing at published precision on the other two. The preprint numbers the same table S3, so a citation of 'Table S3' resolves only against the preprint. And Fig. S1B (p4) is a pie chart of host kingdoms in the filtered IMG/VR subset, with the caption 'We excluded viruses that are likely to infect eukaryotic hosts' — the developers' own figure of what survived their filter, which A2.5 should read against its own result.

sources.title: JGI Data Portal file listing for the IMG/VR dataset (42 files, 10 dated releases)
sources.note: The publisher's own inventory, including an md5sum per file, served without authentication. The dataset identifier Custom_MPI-IMG_VR came from the portal's own redirect rather than a guess: the documented download page is a JavaScript application with no static links. The files themselves return HTTP 401 {"detail":"Authentication credentials were not provided."} and are marked _es_public_data: false, so this entry pins what IMG/VR contains and not its contents. Dated and mutable, like S-OPENGENOME1-TREE: claims from it carry the retrieval date. Two releases answer to 'IMG/VR v4' (2022-09-20 and 2022-12-20); see DECISIONS.md D-052 and D-054.

sources.title: Camargo et al. 2023 — IMG/VR v4: an expanded database of uncultivated virus genomes (Nucleic Acids Research)
sources.licence: publisher content — open access per Unpaywall, licence not stated in the PDF, so not redistributed
sources.note: Retrieved 2026-10-15 by the project owner, who supplied the PDF after four automated access paths were refused (OUP 403; PMC proof-of-work interstitial; the eScholarship and OSTI mirrors HTTP 202 behind a bot challenge). Not stored because the PDF states no redistribution licence, unlike the bioRxiv preprints in pdfs/. Verify against the recorded sha256. It settles three things A4.2 had to bound or report as undocumented, and D-096 records the corrections: geNomad's version is stated as 1.1.0 in Methods, twice and for the marker-based assignment specifically, with Zenodo doi 10.5281/zenodo.7015982 as reference 19 — which is the version A4.2 benchmarked; the ground truth is ICTV Taxonomy Release #37, which is the MSL D-086 pinned; and the taxonomy methods the release note and help page leave out are documented here, so the 'three undocumented methods' finding in D-084 does not survive.
